info.title: SkyWay Airlines API
info.summary: Airline operations API for flights, bookings, tickets, baggage and check-in.
info.description: SkyWay Airlines API lets partners search flights, manage airports, airlines and aircraft, create bookings, issue and refund tickets, register and track baggage, and complete check-in with boarding passes. Requests are authenticated with a bearer token, and list endpoints are paginated with the limit and offset query parameters.

status.description: SCHEDULED is on the timetable, BOARDING means the gate is open, DEPARTED means the aircraft has left, ARRIVED means it has landed, DELAYED means the departure moved to a later time, and CANCELLED means the flight will not operate. A flight moves forward through SCHEDULED, BOARDING, DEPARTED and ARRIVED, and can become DELAYED or CANCELLED before it departs.

Booking.description: A passenger booking on a flight

passportNumber.description: Passport number, accepted on input and never returned in responses

seatNumber.description: Assigned seat, row number followed by a letter

BoardingPass.description: The boarding pass issued after check-in
